en: Color postcard view of an alpine village in a valley surrounded by forested mountains. In the foreground are winding paths through grassy hills leading toward large chalet-style buildings with red-tiled roofs and dark shutters. To the right stands a stone church with a tall bell tower and spire. The scene is framed like a classic tourist postcard, and the caption at the top identifies the place and elevation.
